'''Fish and chips''' is a fried meal that heals {{Hp|14}}, the most of any crafted meal except [[stroganoff]] and [[gnocchi]]. It has no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/fish_and_chips.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[Baked Potato|baked potato]], a [[Cooked Large Fish|cooked large fish]] or [[Cooked Fish|cooked fish]], [[flour]] and [[oil]]. Obtaining a baked potato or oil unlocks the recipe; crafting it returns the oil's glass bottle.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating fish and chips takes 2 seconds and heals {{Hp|14}}.

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].
